title: Compact CLI board overview
description: Onboarding feedback from a board with 24 active cards and 4 features found full list records costly to inspect. Provide an opt-in concise overview; token savings are not yet benchmarked. Do not change existing list JSON by default.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Offer a concise machine-readable overview with full ID, title, status, priority, feature and open-question summary; full show remains available.
Coordinate blocker information with AB-844EFABBB14B when dependencies exist; do not imply unsupported readiness rules.
Document the output and verify existing list output remains compatible.

thread.author: product-manager
thread.body: An independent onboarding report: full list output was truncated at 34 cards. Include assignee and an open-question count in the compact view; make it readable to humans as well as usable by agents, retaining show for full details and descriptive command names. Separately, concise mutation acknowledgments were requested again; consider only after the list view, retaining full output and clear errors.
